opening.argument: The presentation solicits paid participation in BitClub Network as a Bitcoin passive-income opportunity. The displayed page offers mining pools priced from $500 to $3,500, alongside a separate $99 membership offer, while the speaker describes buying shares and receiving a Bitcoin rate every day. He reinforces the solicitation with wallet and pool pages, invites viewers to contact him to begin collecting bitcoins, and asserts a guaranteed profit figure. The appeal to tell others about the offer in connection with earnings further supports the solicitation. Yet the presentation rests on only about a week of activity and provides no statistics, so it does not independently verify mining performance, withdrawals, or actual losses.
